name: pg_event_trigger_oversights_pg_event
subject: Fix oversights in pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() fixes.
goal:
Rows returned by pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() contain inconsistent secondary fields for several object classes. Dropped schemas lack their object_name, default values can claim an object_name they do not have, and triggers or row-level security policies on temporary tables can be reported as non-temporary.

Capture unfiltered sql_drop output while dropping ordinary and temporary schemas, tables, defaults, triggers and policies. A schema row must name the schema, a default-value row must not invent an object name, and objects owned by temporary tables must have is_temporary true while their permanent counterparts remain false. Object identity, address fields, filtering of other sessions' temporary objects and all unaffected object classes must stay stable.
